issues.description: The type of the Course.ratings property is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement explicitly requires ratings to be an array of Int. The template's Course declares ratings as [Int] and its initializer expects ratings: [Int]. However, the solution repository declares ratings as [Double] and its initializer takes ratings: [Double]. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected element type and will cause type errors or incorrect usage when students follow the template/problem text but compare with the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ratings element type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably change the solution to use ratings: [Int] (and update the initializer parameter to ratings: [Int]) so it matches the problem statement and the template. Alternatively, if Double is intended, update the problem statement and template to require ratings: [Double] and adjust addRating and averaging code accordingly.
